perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual at work and remembered her normally being vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay; she said it was “just some personal stuff” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk; she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard her on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He mentioned he’d been reading about financial planning; Patricia said that could be helpful and that she was overwhelmed with her bills lately.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips with her; she thanked him and said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped, so he clarified he only wanted to help, not pry.
- Patricia told him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for his offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said she appreciated having someone to turn to.
- After that, he sensed Patricia preferred handling things privately, so he kept his check-ins light, asking about weekend plans.
- Patricia said she was fine and planning a quiet weekend at home; he offered again to help or chat.
- He continued checking in with her at work and offered help even just for coffee; Patricia said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said his support meant a lot.
